Welcome to The IT Glue API

Intro

Passwords

A password refers to a login credential.

This resource allows you to manage all passwords in your account.

GET /passwords

List or search passwords.

GET /organizations/:organization_id/relationships/passwords

List passwords for an organization.

Returns a list of passwords. See sorting and filter.

Supported Formats

json

CodeDescription
401 Unauthorized
404 Not Found

Create a password.

POST /organizations/:organization_id/relationships/passwords

Create a password for a particular organization.

Creates a password.

}
